fact: Executive decree no. 25-311 of 1 December 2025 amends decree 20-254 of 2020 on the national labelling committee, adds a Scale-up label and states that the Start-up label opens entitlement to state support measures, notably tax advantages.
title: Création du label « Scale-up » : l'Algérie renforce son dispositif de labellisation des start-ups
